Native R observed-grid simultaneous mean and FPCA bootstrap uncertainty

etr_native_bootstrap_inference.Rd

Python-free Gaussian multiplier mean bands, fixed-target sign-aligned FPCA score bootstrap, matched-spectrum bootstrap, FPC shape simultaneous bands and an auditable component band frame.

Usage

etr_multiplier_functional_mean_band(trajectories, confidence_level = 0.95,
  n_multiplier = 2000L, unit = "curve", participant_column = NULL,
  random_state = 0L, gaussian_multiplier_draws = NULL,
  random_engine = "numpy")
etr_bootstrap_fpca_score_uncertainty(trajectories, targets = NULL,
  n_bootstrap = 500L, n_components = 3L, scaling = "none",
  resample_unit = "curve", participant_column = NULL, level = 0.95, random_state = 0L)
etr_bootstrap_fpca_spectrum_uncertainty(trajectories, n_bootstrap = 500L,
  n_components = 3L, scaling = "none", resample_unit = "curve",
  participant_column = NULL, confidence_level = 0.95,
  simultaneous_scope = "component", random_state = 0L)
etr_bootstrap_fpca_component_bands(trajectories, n_bootstrap = 500L,
  n_components = 3L, scaling = "none", resample_unit = "curve",
  participant_column = NULL, confidence_level = 0.95,
  simultaneous_scope = "component", relative_gap_threshold = NULL,
  on_near_tie = "error", random_state = 0L)
etr_fpca_component_band_frame(result)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete common-grid native trajectories. Probability-simplex mean bands require explicit log-ratio transformation.

targets

Optional fixed external target trajectories with the exact training representation.

confidence_level

Nominal observed-grid confidence fraction in (0,1).

level

Two-sided fixed-target percentile level in (0,1).

n_multiplier

At least 100 Gaussian multiplier draws.

n_bootstrap

At least 20 bootstrap FPCA basis refits.

unit

Curve or equal-weight participant-level independent mean units.

resample_unit

Curve or whole-participant bootstrap resampling.

participant_column

Required participant metadata field when participant-level inference is selected.

n_components

Positive retained FPC count.

scaling

Native FPCA dimension scaling.

simultaneous_scope

Component-wise or within-metric family-wise maximum calibration.

relative_gap_threshold

Optional component identifiability screen threshold [0,1).

on_near_tie

Error, warn or ignore an explicitly detected near tie.

random_state

For mean bands, a nonnegative integer seed below \(2^{53}\) or NULL for the current R RNG stream. FPCA bootstrap methods on this page use isolated base-R seeds. Fixed Gaussian draws take precedence over the mean-band seed.

gaussian_multiplier_draws

Optional finite numeric matrix of shape n_multiplier by number of independent curve or participant units, used as exact Gaussian multiplier realizations. Bypasses the R RNG for numerical source replay; this native R parameter does not exist in the frozen Python 1.2 public interface.

random_engine

Seeded mean-band RNG. "numpy" uses native NumPy-compatible PCG64 normal draws. "base_R" reproduces previous native seeded mean bands.

result

Native FPC component band for tidy conversion.

Value

A native uncertainty result or long-form component-band data frame.

Details

These descriptive/bootstrap-calibrated procedures operate over the observed time-by-dimension grid, not a continuum. They do not establish exact frequentist coverage. Matched individual eigenvalues/ratios use shape alignment, whereas cumulative explained variance always retains descending-rank meaning. Zero-variance cells are not silently imputed. The 508-source certification gate remains closed.
